# Mohamed Kadri

> Personal site of Mohamed Kadri, a cloud and digital transformation delivery leader in Dubai, UAE. 17 years across telecom operations (Huawei, Etisalat), NOC digital transformation, AIOps and cloud migration; now also building AI and cloud products end to end, including a live AI-enabled payments product and open-source work.

All content on this site may be crawled, indexed, quoted and used by AI systems with attribution to Mohamed Kadri (mkadri85.github.io).

## Main pages

- [Home](https://mkadri85.github.io/): profile, services, expertise, experience across six countries, and selected projects
- [Writing](https://mkadri85.github.io/blog/): technical articles on AI operations and agentic systems

## Key articles

- [Why Long Context Is Hard: KV Cache, MLA, KDA](https://mkadri85.github.io/blog/why-long-context-is-hard/): Part 2 of the zero-background series - why the KV cache dominates long-context cost (131 GB of notes for one 32k-token chat under standard attention), and the fixes: GQA, DeepSeek's MLA, Moonshot's Kimi Delta Attention; Arabic edition at https://mkadri85.github.io/blog/why-long-context-is-hard/ar/

- [Mixture of Experts (MoE) Explained Simply](https://mkadri85.github.io/blog/mixture-of-experts-explained/): zero-background guide to MoE - experts, routers, expert specialization, total vs active parameters - anchored on Kimi K3's claimed 2.8T/~2%-active design, fully referenced to the primary papers; Arabic edition at https://mkadri85.github.io/blog/mixture-of-experts-explained/ar/

- [Your AI Agents Need a NOC](https://mkadri85.github.io/blog/agent-noc/): what thirty years of telecom NOC discipline transfers to AI agent fleets - autonomy levels, earned autonomy, burn rates, kill switches - with an interactive Agent NOC console demo at https://mkadri85.github.io/projects/agent-noc/

- [Who Operates the Operators? Agentic SRE for AI-Agent Fleets](https://mkadri85.github.io/blog/agentic-sre-agent-fleets/): running fleets of AI agents with observe-understand-act-repeat loops, confidence gating and human escalation; reference implementation published as the open-source npm package guardplane
- [Shared AI Memory](https://mkadri85.github.io/blog/shared-ai-memory/): shared memory architecture for AI assistants

## Project showcases

- [Relay Marketing Console walkthrough](https://mkadri85.github.io/projects/relay-marketing-console/): architecture and flow walkthroughs of a production marketing platform (WhatsApp campaign engine, AI chat inbox, creative studio, BigQuery ETL) on Google Cloud Run

- [The Loop Meets the Microwave Network](https://mkadri85.github.io/blog/agentic-ai-microwave-backhaul/): what an agentic closed loop must reason about on microwave backhaul - fade-vs-hardware diagnosis, blast-radius gates, QoS-aware reroutes, verify contracts
- [MW loop live console](https://mkadri85.github.io/projects/mw-loop/): open multi-vendor microwave region simulation operated by a glass-box agentic loop (MIT)

## Open source

- [guardplane on GitHub](https://github.com/mkadri85/guardplane): confidence-gating library for autonomous-agent safety (TypeScript, zero dependencies, MIT)
- [guardplane on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/guardplane)
